title: Tournament-Day Cash Games
html:
Tournament Day Cash Games

Tournament-Day Cash Games

Optional Side Games for DC Metro Golfweek Amateur Events
2026 Tournament Day Cash Games ($40 Buy-In Total)
Payments for Day Cash Games are collected on-site the day of the event. Please bring the exact amount in CASH.
For Two-Day tournaments, all Day Monies ($80 total) are collected on Day 1.

Flight Skins Game

$10 Entry

If you are the only player in your flight to post a Birdie or Better on a hole during the tournament, you win that hole's skin.

Flight Skins may be modified depending on the number of players in each flight at that tournament.

Super Skins

$10 Entry

If you are the only player to post a Birdie or Better on a hole during the tournament, you win a skin.

Super Skins include ALL flights competing together.

Polies

$10 Entry

All money goes into one pot for players participating.

Any player who hits their tee shot within the length of the flagstick on a Par 3 shares in the pot.

50 / 50 Raffle

Optional

Open to all players.

50% of the pot goes to the player who wins the raffle.

50% is donated to the Golfweek Amateur Tour National Cancer Campaign benefiting the V-Foundation.

In 2025 DC Metro Donated $2,950 to the V-Foundation!

Bring CASH with you for the Cash Games!

Posted: 3/11/2026 12:48:39 PM
